sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import Counter

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
colors = Counter(n['color'] for n in nodes)
print(f"Colors: {dict(colors)}")

greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")

# Check purple strip
purple_strips = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p' and n['pixels'] > 100]
print(f"Purple strips: {len(purple_strips)}")

# Check agent
agent = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
print(f"Agent: boundary={agent['boundary']}")

# Click on ONE green block at a time
# Start with the leftmost one
leftmost_green = min(greens, key=lambda g: min(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']))
boundary = leftmost_green['boundary']
rows = [pt[0] for pt in boundary]
cols = [pt[1] for pt in boundary]
center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
print(f"\nClicking leftmost green at ({center_row}, {center_col})")

action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col}])

seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
greens2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks after: {len(greens2)}")
print(f"Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
